t_advice_summary_textbox.text: From what I understand, the colour does not matter according to him as there will be gnomes that will come with higher points and be smart enough not to be too slow in your decision making. then, he said good luck.

vb_textbox.text: found that during the different rounds, certain gnomes were better for me in the amount of mushrooms I got. Whichever color works best for you in the round, keep choosing them and that will help give you a lot more points when the 5x multiplier comes up. After each break, some of the gnomes that gave me better points before don't anymore, so try to remember the other colored gnomes that now are better for your points. Some of the gnomes for me still gave me a good amount of points but some changed.It does not really matter the character you choose, just keep trying them out and ensure you meet up with the timing.  Good luck!
